name: Inputs uploaded
measures: Source files taken into the platform; shows whether the engagement is being fed. Falling to zero means the process has no current evidence behind it.

name: Memory artifacts created
measures: Artifacts committed to process memory; shows the system is producing, not just reading.

name: Token consumption
measures: Model tokens consumed; the running cost of the deployment and the trigger for a budget conversation.
formula: sum of prompt and completion tokens across all agents

name: Agent error rate
measures: Share of agent runs ending in error; the first signal that a prompt, a schema or an upstream system has changed under the deployment.
formula: runs ending in error / total runs x 100

name: Agents live
measures: Production agents currently serving; anything below the expected count is an outage somebody has not noticed.
formula: count of deployed agents reporting healthy

name: Tokens per agent
measures: Where the model spend actually goes; identifies the one agent worth optimising.
formula: sum of tokens grouped by agent

name: API hits
measures: Requests served by the integrated APIs; the load the client's systems are actually carrying because of this deployment.
formula: count of API calls grouped by endpoint

name: API live status
measures: Health of the integrated workflow APIs; an integration down is a process stopped, whatever the agents report.
formula: endpoints responding healthy / endpoints monitored x 100

name: Data extraction time
measures: How long a source document takes to convert; the part of the pipeline a user waits on.
formula: elapsed time from upload accepted to conversion committed
report_as: p50 and p90, alert above 10 minutes at p90

name: Manual BMI Correction Rate
measures: Detects cases where underwriters manually override automatically calculated BMI values, informing decisions on system bug fixes for imperial-to-metric conversions.
grain: Per underwriting case requiring medical exams
formula: Number of cases where medical results BMI was manually modified divided by total number of cases with completed Medical Examiner Reports (MER).

name: Medical Requirement Order Rework Rate
measures: Measures how often medical tests are amended after the initial decision stage, informing decisions to digitize and automate the age/sum assured medical grid.
formula: Number of cases where medical requirements are added, cancelled, or modified after the initial determination stage (S3) divided by total cases with ordered medical requirements.

name: Non-Compliant Extra Mortality (EM) Overrides
measures: Tracks overrides processed without mandatory text justifications, informing validation enforcement decisions to avoid audit failures.
grain: Per manual extra mortality override action
formula: Number of manual rating overrides completed where the override reason field is empty or blank divided by the total number of manual rating overrides.

name: Provisional Referral Turnaround Time
measures: Measures the latency to dispatch early warnings to Atlas Re, informing decisions on fast-track referral routing configurations.
formula: Time elapsed between application registration (S1) and dispatch of the provisional summary to Atlas Re (S4).
counter_metric: Provisional Referral Reversion Rate (where final rating differs significantly from provisional best-guess)
